animated tattoo, large.description: An animated tattoo can change appearance, move across the body, change colors, or animate, and is created using magically infused inks or dyes.

animated tattoo, small.description: An animated tattoo can change appearance, move across the body, change colors, or animate, and is created using magically infused inks or dyes.

bioluminescent runemarks.description: Implanted rune-carved wires emit dim light in a 5-foot radius and allow you to communicate in Bioluminescent Sign Language.

dark matter crystal implant.description: Choose one sorcerer cantrip; you know it and use Charisma as its spellcasting modifier, and you can have no more than 2 implants.

dark matter particle funnel.description: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws against radiant damage or radiation sickness.

dimensional pocket.description: The implant creates a dimensional pocket space that stores one non-living object weighing 10 lbs. or less, refreshes its air periodically, and opens when its chosen command word is spoken.

mageware ears.description: Mageware ears replace your ears and can be modified with additional features.

mageware amplification.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to sound.

mageware eyes.description: Mageware eyes replace your eyes and serve as the base for various upgrades.

mageware darkvision.description: You gain darkvision out to 60 feet.

mageware magnification.description: You can see up to three times farther than normal with great clarity, without affecting other types of sight.

magesight.description: As a bonus action, you can see magical auras within 30 feet for 1 minute, as if you had cast detect magic; this ability recharges after 10 minutes.

mageware limb.description: Mageware limbs can replace arms or legs and support up to four add-ons, with only one add-on active at a time.

mageware limb compartment.description: A mageware limb compartment stores items, and retrieving or stowing items from it grants advantage on Stealth checks.

mageware limb weapon.description: A built-in melee weapon is magical for overcoming damage resistances and immunities, requires an interaction to draw if retracted, and costs the weapon’s normal price in addition to the add-on.

mageware limb extension.description: Mageware arms extend your reach to 10 feet, while mageware legs double your jump distance.

mageware limb strengthening.description: You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made using your mageware limbs.

telekinetic hand conductor.description: You gain a phantom hand that can interact with objects within 10 feet, exert up to 5 pounds of pressure, and carry up to 10 lbs.

mageware fractal wings.description: You gain a 20-foot fly speed, considered magical flight.

runic vein stents.description: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against effects that impose the poisoned condition.

dermal abjuration bolsters.description: While not wearing armor, your base AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier, and this counts as wearing armor for abilities that modify AC.

acceleration node.description: Your movement speed increases by 10 feet.

stamina reinforcement module.description: Your hit points increase by an amount equal to your level, and you gain 1 additional hit point whenever you gain a level. This augmentation cannot be used with mageware limbs, bone lacing, or bone reinforcement.

telepathic crux chip.description: You can communicate telepathically with a creature within 30 feet if you share at least one language.

vocal calibrator.description: You can alter the tone, pitch, speed, and other aspects of your voice, and can speak aloud even if you were previously unable to.

potion of climbing.description: Grants a climb speed and advantage on climbing for 1 hour

potion of comprehension.description: Understand all languages for 1 hour (Comprehend Languages)

potion of watchful rest.description: You cannot be magically put to sleep and do not need sleep for 8 hours of rest

bottled breath.description: Hold your breath for 1 hour or create gust-force air bursts

oil of slipperiness.description: Grants Freedom of Movement or Grease effect for 8 hours

philter of love.description: Become charmed by the next creature you see

potion of advantage.description: Gain advantage on one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check

potion of fire breath.description: Breathe fire 3 times (4d6 fire damage each)

potion of poison.description: Appears like normal health potion but deals 3d6 poison damage instead

potion of polychromy.description: Change colors; advantage on stealth for 1 hour

potion of psionic fortitude.description: Advantage against charm effects for 1 hour

potion of resistance (acid).description: Resistance to acid damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (cold).description: Resistance to cold damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (fire).description: Resistance to fire damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (force).description: Resistance to force damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (lightning).description: Resistance to lightning damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (necrotic).description: Resistance to necrotic damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (poison).description: Resistance to poison damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (psychic).description: Resistance to psychic damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (radiant).description: Resistance to radiant damage for 1 hour

potion of resistance (thunder).description: Resistance to thunder damage for 1 hour

potion of stoneskin.description: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing for 1 hour

potion of water breathing.description: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour

elixir of health.description: Cures diseases and removes several conditions

potion of heroism.description: Gain temp HP and Bless effect for 1 hour

potion of invulnerability.description: Resistance to all damage for 1 hour

the emperor's new clothes.description: A set of fabulous clothes that only intelligent people can see and invisible to those who aren't. The only problem is that the spellcaster who made it had an intelligence of 30.
